```
['run the neuralfeels entrypoint script with hydra config to start tactile SLAM training and visualization', 'run a single optimization iteration that performs map and pose optimization steps on the trainer', 'run incremental frame loading to fetch new sensor frames and keyframes from the trainer', 'create an OptionalDisplay context manager that conditionally starts a pyvirtualdisplay for headless rendering', 'review the OptionalDisplay class that wraps pyvirtualdisplay with conditional activation via the active flag']
```

